behavior: One overdue native callback drains the bounded due-frame queue before returning to unrelated timers. Each frame keeps its original target and 50ms late allowance. Future frames retain one head timer. A callback processes no more than its initial queue length, even under reentrant callbacks.

counterexamples: After a 1686ms wake only one of three expired originals is released; two remain queued.
At a 140ms wake an expired80ms frame is dropped but the due113ms frame is postponed behind a new timer.

verification.coverage: Steady30Hz native target scheduling, six-frame capacity, original source horizon/late discard, clear/close, delayed full/mixed drains, early wake and close from a paint callback.
